request.description: PRIMARY OCR ENDPOINT: Extract text from image files OR PDF files using enhanced pdf2pic + Tesseract.js processing. This endpoint accepts files with field name 'image' - ideal for image-specific uploads or when semantic clarity is preferred. OPTIMIZED FOR PRESENTATION SLIDES: Step 1: Converts PDF pages to high-quality PNG images using pdf2pic (buffer-based processing). Step 2: Uses Tesseract PSM 11 (sparse text) perfect for slide layouts. Step 3: Extracts text from charts/diagrams/embedded images. Step 4: Combines regular PDF text + OCR results intelligently.
